title: Anaerobic oxidation of methane and its potential role in heavy metal(loid) speciation in wetland soils: Occurrence, mechanisms and environmental implications
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00793C, Critical Review
Wei Ye, Lihu Liu, Zhaozhi Zheng, Shengwen Xu, Yongxiang Yu, Ningguo Zheng, Yongbao Zhang, Huaiying Yao
Wetlands deliver essential ecological services but are increasingly threatened by heavy metal(loid)s (HMs) due to anthropogenic activities. The speciation of HMs, which dictates their toxicity and mobility, can be transformed...
